transport.negotiation: call host.info; check features includes tavi.assets/v1; permissions via host session; deny if missing
transport.authentication: host derives caller identity and scope from authenticated extension session, verified manifest digest and TaviX tavix.asset-grants/v1 projection; pack-scoped capability and preference rights checked independently on every request
transport.sdk: sdk/client.mjs and sdk/index.d.ts are transport-injected reference clients, not a TaviX runtime implementation

requests.authorization: host-granted customization permission and host-owned user consent policy

requests.format: bounded base64, media type and selected variant; no paths or arbitrary URLs

requests.authorization: only installed pack IDs granted by trusted host session; expose only granted capabilities
search across session-granted installed packs only; resource list filtered to capabilities granted to caller
each slot requires installed and granted pack + capability; no compositing of images and no entitlement bypass
Only verified installed application declarations and session-derived grants; no caller-supplied requirements, identity, purchase or path

events.status: not implemented or emitted by Tavi; clients must function without notifications

metadata.rulesRef: opaque identifier for game-owned behavior mapping; never script or executable logic
metadata.rarity: OPTIONAL, game-specific classification only; absence has no implicit common tier, price or entitlement; legacy pack-specific rarity filter remains supported
metadata.ownership: catalog price and pack metadata never provide an entitlement
metadata.modifiers: optional declarative tavi.cards.modifiers.v1 trigger/condition/effects; parsed but never executed by Tavi Assets; game runtime must explicitly opt into and validate profile, op support and balancing

errors: resource too large for inline host transport
security: media capability grants are separate from pack metadata
no purchases or install from extension
all source bytes and references revalidated
TaviX scoped grants validated against requested packs/capabilities and verified manifest identity/digest
No legacy flat pack x capability cross-product grants
Object and collection metadata filtered before totals/pagination by pack-scoped resource capability

marketplace.rarity: optional game-owned object metadata only; never required for purchase, pricing or availability
marketplace.bundles: contracts/tavi-assets-customization-bundle-v1.schema.json describes read-only content composition, not entitlement or pricing
marketplace.offers: contracts/tavi-assets-store-offer-v1.schema.json is an illustrative storefront catalog contract only; purchase authorization remains LoopRD/Wallet
marketplace.variantEntitlements: not enforced by this developer runtime; do not expose individually paid variants before host grants them

dependencies.requirementsSource: Host-verified TaviX 0.1.11 manifest.assetDependencies; optional additional host-owned requirements for feature grouping; never request params
dependencies.fallback: optional missing does not prevent base game or bundled content; required is per-feature

limits.fullDeckDiscovery: requires reviewed collection/group permission in TaviX; current SDK exposes only approved subsets
